files.head:
# ledger

ledger is a small command-line account book. It stores dates, accounts, categories, amounts, and notes in CSV files.

## Record a payment

Add a row to ledger.csv. Use a negative amount for an expense and a positive amount for income.

```csv
date,account,category,amount,note
2026-04-03,cash,food,-12.50,Lunch
2026-04-04,bank,income,2400.00,Salary
```

Amounts use two decimal places. All accounts in one file use the same currency.

## Read entries

Run the command from the directory that contains the account book.

```sh
ledger -file ledger.csv -month 2026-04
```

The command prints up to 20 entries in date order.

## Account filter

Use an account name to restrict the output.

```sh
ledger -account cash
```

Account names are case-sensitive. An empty account filter includes every account.

## Monthly totals

Category totals include the number of payments and the amount in cents. An empty category keeps an empty label.

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Date | Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form |
| Amount | Signed amount with a decimal point |
| Note | Optional description of the payment |

## Keep a copy

Copy ledger.csv before a large import. Keep the original bank statement until the totals agree.

# ledger

ledger is a small command-line account book. It stores dates, accounts, categories, amounts, and notes in CSV files.

## Record a payment

Add a row to ledger.csv. Use a negative amount for an expense and a positive amount for income.

```csv
date,account,category,amount,note
2026-04-03,cash,food,-12.50,Lunch
2026-04-04,bank,income,2400.00,Salary
```

Amounts accept one or two decimal places. Spaces around an amount are ignored. All accounts in one file use the same currency.

## Read entries

Run the command from the directory that contains the account book.

```sh
ledger -file ledger.csv -month 2026-04
```

The command prints up to 50 entries in date order.

## Account filter

Use an account name to restrict the output.

```sh
ledger -account cash
```

Account names are case-sensitive. An empty account filter includes every account.

## Monthly totals

Category totals include the number of payments and the amount in cents. An empty category uses the label `uncategorized`.

| Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| Date | Calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD form |
| Amount | Signed amount with a decimal point |
| Note | Optional description of the payment |

## Keep a copy

Copy ledger.csv before a large import. Keep the original bank statement until the totals agree.

# Changelog

## 0.2.0

### Account books

- Read five columns from CSV account books.
- Filter payments by account and month.
- Print a maximum of 20 entries.

### Totals

Category totals report amounts in cents. Month labels use the full month name.

## 0.1.0

The first version reads dates and signed amounts from a local CSV file.
